description_en: Sets the scheduler configuration for a specified cluster
description_zh: 为指定集群设置调度器配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc set-scheduler-info --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id 'ehpc-hz-FYUr32****' --scheduler SchedName=pbs --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetSchedulerInfo

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188593.html to query the region IDs supported by E-HPC
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188593.html获取E-HPC支持的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html to query the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html获取集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

fields.help_en:
The usernames of users restricted to use the queue. Separate multiple usernames with commas (,).

If usernames are specified, PbsInfo.N.AclLimit.N.Queue is required
fields.help_zh:
限制该队列使用的用户名，多个用户用`,`隔开。

当设置了用户名时，PbsInfo.N.AclLimit.N.Queue为必选
fields.name: acl_users

fields.help_en:
The queue limit for users. Valid values of N: 0 to 100.

For example, if PbsInfo.N.AclLimit.N.Queue is set to workq and PbsInfo.N.AclLimit.N.AclUsers is set to user1,user2, the workq queue can only be used by user1 and user2
fields.help_zh:
AclLimit指用户使用的队列限制。N的取值范围：0~100。

假设`PbsInfo.N.AclLimit.N.Queue`设置为`workq`，`PbsInfo.N.AclLimit.N.AclUsers`设置为`user1,user2`，表示队列workq只能被user1和user2使用
fields.name: queue

fields.help_en:
The retention period of jobs. Job data is destroyed after the retention period expires. Unit: days.    
Valid values: 1 to 30.    
Default value: 14
fields.help_zh:
作业保留时间，超过保留之间后，作业数据会被销毁。单位为天。    
取值范围：1~30。    
默认值：14
fields.name: job_history_duration

fields.help_en: The maximum number of vCPUs that the cluster user can use on nodes in the queue
fields.help_zh: 集群用户使用队列中节点的最大vCPU个数
fields.name: cpus

fields.help_en: The maximum number of jobs that the cluster user can submit. If the total number of running and queued jobs of the user exceeds this value, no more jobs can be submitted
fields.help_zh: 集群用户提交的最大作业数目。若用户的运行和排队作业数目总和超过此数值则将无法再继续提交作业
fields.name: max_jobs

fields.help_en:
The maximum memory resources that the cluster user can use in the queue. Valid units:

gb

mb

kb
fields.help_zh:
集群用户使用队列的最大内存资源。单位取值范围：

gb

mb

kb
fields.name: mem

fields.help_en: The maximum number of nodes that the cluster user can use in the queue
fields.help_zh: 集群用户使用队列的最大节点个数
fields.name: nodes

fields.help_en:
The number of PBS scheduler settings that can be configured in the cluster. Valid values of N for PbsInfo: 0 to 100.

The queue resource limits for the user. Valid values of N for ResourceLimit: 0 to 100.

The name of the queue used by the cluster user to run jobs.

If any of the User, Cpus, Nodes, or Mem parameters is specified in ResourceLimit, Queue is required
fields.help_zh:
PbsInfo指集群中可以设置的PBS调度信息个数。N的取值范围：0~100。

ResourceLimit指用户使用的队列资源限制。N的取值范围：0~100。

Queue指该集群用户运行作业使用的队列名称。

当ResourceLimit中设置了User、Cpus、Nodes、Mem中任一一个参数时，Queue为必选
fields.name: queue

fields.help_en: The username of the cluster user that runs the job
fields.help_zh: 运行作业的集群用户名
fields.name: user

fields.help_en: The list of node information for cluster users
fields.help_zh: 集群用户使用的节点信息列表
fields.name: resource_limit

fields.help_en:
The number of PBS scheduler settings that can be configured in the cluster. Valid values of N for PbsInfo: 0 to 100.

The scheduling interval. Unit: seconds.

The scheduling interval is the time interval between running multiple jobs. For example, if this parameter is set to 60, the next job can start running only 60 seconds after the current job starts running.

Default value: 60
fields.help_zh:
PbsInfo指集群中可以设置的PBS调度信息个数。N的取值范围：0~100。

SchedInterval指调度周期，单位：秒

调度周期指运行多个作业之间时间间隔，如设置为60，表示本次作业开始运行60秒后才能开始运行下次作业。

默认值：60
fields.name: sched_interval

fields.help_en: The maximum number of jobs that can be scheduled in the cluster. If the total number of queued and running jobs in the cluster exceeds this value, no more jobs can be submitted. Default value: 20000
fields.help_zh: 集群调度的最大作业数。若集群排队和运行的作业数总和超过此数值则无法再继续提交作业。默认值：20000
fields.name: sched_max_jobs

fields.help_en: The maximum number of queued jobs that can be scheduled in the cluster. If the number of queued jobs in the cluster exceeds this value, no more jobs can be submitted. Default value: 10000
fields.help_zh: 集群调度的最大排队作业数。若集群排队作业数量超过此数值则无法再继续提交作业。默认值：10000
fields.name: sched_max_queued_jobs

parameters.help_en: The list of PBS scheduler information
parameters.name: pbs_info

fields.help_en:
The backfill scheduling interval. Unit: seconds.

Default value: 60
fields.help_zh:
Backfill调度周期设置，单位：秒

默认值：60
fields.name: backfill_interval

fields.help_en:
The number of Slurm scheduler settings that can be configured in the cluster. Valid values of N for SlurmInfo: 0 to 100.

The main scheduling interval. Unit: seconds.

Default value: 60
fields.help_zh:
SlurmInfo指集群中可以设置的Slurm调度信息个数。N的取值范围：0~100。

SchedInterval指主调度周期设置，单位：秒

默认值：60
fields.name: sched_interval

parameters.help_en: The list of Slurm scheduler information
parameters.name: slurm_info

fields.help_en:
The scheduler name. Valid values:

pbs
pbs19
slurm
slurm19
slurm20

If the scheduler is pbs or pbs19, at least one of the PbsInfo.N.SchedInterval, PbsInfo.N.JobHistoryDuration, PbsInfo.N.ResourceLimit, and PbsInfo.N.AclLimit parameters is required. If the scheduler is slurm, slurm19, or slurm20, at least one of the SlurmInfo.N.SchedInterval and SlurmInfo.N.BackfillInterval parameters is required
fields.help_zh:
调度器名，取值范围：

pbs
pbs19
slurm
slurm19
slurm20

调度器为pbs、pbs19时，PbsInfo.N.SchedInterval、PbsInfo.N.JobHistoryDuration、PbsInfo.N.ResourceLimit、PbsInfo.N.AclLimit中至少一个参数为必选；调度器为slurm、slurm19、slurm20时，SlurmInfo.N.SchedInterval、SlurmInfo.N.BackfillInterval中至少一个参数为必选
fields.name: sched_name
